decisions.reason: The finned tube is a low-cost component close to the firm's core air-cooler business, and it survived the 2019 pruning that removed four sibling launches, so keeping the option open costs little while its value is still unresolved.

The enhanced heat exchanger tubes build directly on established tube manufacturing and still had their own page in 2019 with no evidence of failure, so the cheap-to-carry option is worth more than the resources dropping it would free up.
